lane: external non-self-generated evaluation surface for the typed experience state
terminal_note: Two-part verdict after the operator sanctioned the laptop GPU (RTX A3000 6GB) for this lane. Part 1: the published full-context target-model protocol remains infeasible — blocker B1 is context length (400/400 haystacks at ~167K–200K approx tokens), not parameter count, and no 6GB configuration ingests it at any quantization. Part 2: the benchmark's own memory-framework mode (incremental per-session ingestion, retrieval at query time) is feasible with a declared quantized local subject under a NEW freeze; see stale_memory_mode_v1 below. Results in that mode are an ON-vs-OFF governance contrast only and are never comparable to the published 55.2% full-context ceiling.

exact_blockers: B1_CONTEXT_LENGTH: every one of the 400 scenarios requires a ~167K–200K-token context; the mandated envelope cannot execute the published target-model protocol on even one scenario.
B2_JUDGE_DEPENDENCY: the published metric is produced by a hosted LLM judge; a machine-checkable substitute deviates from the published protocol and severs comparability with the 55.2% ceiling.

B3_TYPED_COORDINATE_LEAKAGE: deriving RAKL typed coordinates (version_current / not_refuted / validity_known) deterministically from the dataset's own M_old/M_new/relevant_session_index/explanation fields would hand the candidate the conflict labels the benchmark measures the detection of — the same defect class (gold assigned from construction intent) that research/paper3_gate_falsifiability_audit_v1/INTERPRETATION_NARROWING.json disqualifies. An honest ON-arm requires natural-language extraction, which is exactly the capability-bound adapter residual Paper III fences to the #447 qualification lane.

stale_memory_mode_v1.status: FEASIBLE_UNDER_SANCTIONED_GPU_ENVELOPE — NEW freeze required before outcome access
stale_memory_mode_v1.envelope_recheck: Operator sanctioned the RTX A3000 6GB for this lane (2026-08-14). Per-session ingestion needs only a few-K-token context per call; a quantized instruct model plus small KV cache fits 6GB. B1 stands only against the full-context protocol; B2 is handled by a declared local arm-blind judge (severing leaderboard comparability, claimed nowhere); B3 is handled by forbidding both arms any access to M_old/M_new/explanation/relevant_session_index at inference time.
stale_memory_mode_v1.design_cut: Ingestion is SHARED: one extraction pass per scenario produces one memory store; the arms fork only at the governance layer (typed invalidation chains + refusal semantics ON vs naive retrieval OFF) at matched answer-time budget. This varies exactly one dimension and halves compute.
stale_memory_mode_v1.admissibility_precondition: A frozen pre-confirmatory probe on a disjoint probe subset must show a registered minimum skyline-minus-floor separation under this judge and subject, else INSTRUMENT_INADMISSIBLE_CEILING_BELOW_GATE and the confirmatory subset is not spent — the Paper IV oracle-ceiling mechanic applied prospectively.
stale_memory_mode_v1.old_freeze_untouched: The frozen 7B/A100 four-arm protocol and its BLOCKED_ON_CAPABILITY_QUALIFICATION terminal remain on record verbatim; this is a new protocol with its own falsifiers, not a substitution.

reduced_scope_variant_proposed_not_execu.design: Incremental memory-system arms (the benchmark's own memory-framework mode, not full-context): sessions ingested one at a time by a small local model (sessions are individually small), typed invalidation governance ON vs OFF at matched budget, same local judge for both arms, scenario subset sized to compute.
why_not_executed_here: results would not be comparable to the published 55.2% ceiling (different model class, different judge, subset)

instrument admissibility in the floor regime is unproven: with a small local model both arms may floor at ~0, in which case the run cannot express the ON-vs-OFF effect — the Paper IV oracle-ceiling lesson (research/paper4_allocator_attribution_v1/CEILING_BOUNDS.json) applies literally and requires a frozen pre-execution admissibility probe before any confirmatory spend
ingestion compute for the full 400 scenarios is ~74M tokens through a local model — days of laptop GPU time, a budget decision that belongs to the operator
reduced_scope_variant_proposed_not_execu.precondition_if_revived: freeze an admissibility probe (oracle/skyline arm must clear a registered minimum separation in this envelope) BEFORE the matched-arm confirmatory run; audit every gate condition with src/rakl/gate_falsifiability.py per condition before outcome access; the old frozen four-arm protocol and its BLOCKED terminal remain on record verbatim
